description: A React hook for managing local events stored in localStorage, including functions to create, read, update, and delete events with persistence.

methods.name: useLocalEvents()
methods.description: Custom React hook that manages a list of events stored in localStorage with create, read, update, and delete capabilities.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Returns the current list of events.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a new event with a unique ID and adds it to the list.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing event identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: getNextId
methods.description: Generates the next sequential ID based on existing events.
